SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname FROM `user` u INNER JOIN `role` r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE u.status = 1 AND LOWER(r.role_code) = 'farm_owner' ORDER BY u.id DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `farm_owner_user` fou JOIN `user` u ON u.id = fou.user_id JOIN `role` r ON r.id = u.role_id AND LOWER(r.role_code) = 'user' WHERE fou.owner_user_id = #{ownerId} AND fou.user_id = #{userId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `farm_owner_technician` fot JOIN `user` u ON u.id = fot.technician_user_id JOIN `role` r ON r.id = u.role_id AND LOWER(r.role_code) = 'technician' WHERE fot.owner_user_id = #{ownerId} AND fot.technician_user_id = #{userId} AND fot.status = 1)

SELECT fou.owner_user_id FROM `farm_owner_user` fou JOIN `user` owner ON owner.id = fou.owner_user_id AND owner.status = 1 JOIN `user` worker ON worker.id = fou.user_id AND worker.status = 1 JOIN `role` owner_role ON owner_role.id = owner.role_id AND LOWER(owner_role.role_code) = 'farm_owner' JOIN `role` worker_role ON worker_role.id = worker.role_id AND LOWER(worker_role.role_code) = 'user' WHERE fou.user_id = #{userId}
